lede: Vancouver had last change, so Manny Malhotra picked most of these matchups. Vancouver played without Guillaume Brisebois and Jacob Quillan. The Rangers played without Matt Rempe.

notes.head: The fourth line drew Tolvanen’s line
notes.text: Manny Malhotra sent O'Connor, Sasson and Gallagher out for 5:58 of their 8:19 at 5-on-5 against Chmelař, Gawdin and Tolvanen (72%, about 19% with no line matching), and they had the better of the chances, 0.51 to 0.19 expected goals.

notes.head: E. Pettersson’s line drew Zibanejad’s line
notes.text: DeBrusk, E. Pettersson and Boeser spent 10:08 of their 13:42 at 5-on-5 against Perreault, Zibanejad and Lafrenière (74%, about 31% with no line matching), and they had the better of the chances, 0.44 to 0.28 expected goals. The only Vancouver goal came then.

notes.head: The third line drew Cuylle’s line
notes.text: Öhgren, Rossi and Karlsson spent 7:32 of their 12:18 at 5-on-5 against Cuylle, Laba and Bjorkstrand (61%, about 23% with no line matching), and they had the worse of the chances, 0.09 to 0.44 expected goals.

notes.head: One matchup went wrong
notes.text: Lekkerimäki, Chytil and Cotter kept drawing the Rangers’ second line, Kartye, Miller and Dorofeyev. In those 7:45 the Rangers had 1.01 expected goals to Vancouver’s 0.10.

foot: Manny Malhotra matched about as hard as in his other home games: each line spent 67% of its time against one opposing line, against 38% to 70% in his first nine.
